requirement: The system shall allow users to register, sign in, and view authorized user details. Protected account, workspace, and battle operations shall require a user identity authenticated by a valid JWT bearer token; missing or malformed tokens shall be rejected with an authentication error.
The system shall allow authorized users to create, view, and update projects, create project versions, and initialize the files associated with each version.

The system shall provide real-time code editing in project-version workspaces, communicate each user's access and read-only status, and leave editing disabled for unauthorized access or missing project/version information. It shall coordinate editing activity and remove stale workspace participation state when users leave or disconnect. Live workspace updates shall use Socket.IO, and operations that require Redis shall run only when Redis is ready.
The system shall allow users to submit code for compilation or execution in an isolated Docker-based sandbox and receive the execution status, output, and error details where applicable.
The system shall record users' coding operations in time-series storage and allow users to retrieve and replay the coding process for a selected project, version, and time range.

The system shall allow authenticated users to invite other users to real-time coding battles, accept invitations, indicate readiness, synchronize code, submit code for judging, receive win/loss outcomes, and leave battles. It shall limit repeated invitations within the configured short period, expire temporary invitations, and permit each invitation to be accepted at most once by a user other than its inviter, including during concurrent acceptance. It shall report failure when an invitation has expired, a user accepts their own invitation, invitation data cannot be read, or battle creation fails, using Redis to coordinate invitation and battle state.

The system shall store uploaded code files, battle result files, user files, static assets, and archives in object storage and provide distributable URLs through which the successfully stored files can be retrieved.

The system shall provide a Vue browser application and support automated deployment of its Node.js/Express backend, REST and Socket.IO communication, Nginx reverse proxy, MySQL relational storage, InfluxDB or configured equivalent time-series storage, Redis coordination, Docker sandbox, object storage, and content distribution services.
